review_scope: Exact-hash one-row incremental successor to v0.10. IIJ Shiroi Phase 3 inherits the default not-reviewed outcome and adds no independent imagery review. No satellite, aerial, publisher, rendered-map, computer-vision, or analyst visual evidence contributes to identity, lifecycle, construction, capacity, power, energy, workload, role, operating model, geometry, building count, progress, or unique-site claims. The e-Stat shapefile is structured statistical boundary data, not imagery review.
